FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a grand, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty? But we are in the Middle Ages.

KING
(nodding)
Exactly! That is precisely the point. We must break free from the shackles of tradition and forge a new path. A path that is... (he gestures grandly)...vaporwave.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king, surrounded by his courtiers and advisors, begins to unveil his vision. The room is filled with an assortment of strange and wondrous objects: a fog machine, a fog-colored tapestry, and a collection of vintage VHS tapes.

KING
(to his courtiers)
We shall adorn our castle walls with the finest examples of... of... (he consults a parchment)...of "retro-futurism".

COURTIER 1 (she)
But, Your Majesty, what about the traditional heraldry? The lions and the dragons?

KING
(waving his hand dismissively)
Pfft, those are so... so... (he searches for the right words)...so... medieval. We shall replace them with... with... (he consults another parchment)...with "neon-lit, pixelated, cyberpunk-inspired motifs".

COURTIER 2 (he)
But, sire, what about the peasants? They will be confused by these... these... (he gestures to the fog machine)...these "fog machines".

KING
(laughing)
Ah, but that is the beauty of it! We shall create a sense of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of "disorientation". A sense of disorientation that will make them question their very reality.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The castle walls are adorned with neon-lit, pixelated, cyberpunk-inspired motifs. The streets are filled with fog machines, and the peasants are wandering about, looking confused and disoriented.

KING
(to Zorvath)
Behold, my friend! Our empire is now a true... a true... (he searches for the right words)...a true "proto-vaporwave" utopia.

ZORVATH
(smirking)
Well, Your Majesty, I must say... I am... I am... (he searches for the right words)...I am impressed.

KING
(smiling)
Good! For I am the greatest king the world has ever known. And I shall not rest until my empire is the most... the most... (he searches for the right words)...the most "vaporwave" empire in all the land.

FADE TO BLACK.
